title: Bhutanese Boulangerie
subtitle: Hospitality Architecture
description: A contemporary café and bakery that blends French boulangerie traditions with Bhutanese hospitality. The warm, welcoming space features locally sourced materials and showcases traditional Bhutanese craftsmanship alongside modern café design principles.

title: Pangbesa Farmhouse
subtitle: Residential Architecture
description: A contemporary residential retreat that respects the natural landscape of Paro valley. The design balances modern comfort with traditional Bhutanese architectural elements. Large windows frame mountain views while sustainable features ensure minimal environmental impact.

title: Yangkhil Café
subtitle: Hospitality Architecture
description: A charming café that celebrates Bhutanese hospitality and culture. The intimate design creates a warm, inviting atmosphere where visitors can experience authentic Bhutanese hospitality. Local materials and traditional design elements are thoughtfully integrated throughout.

title: Bhutan National Bank
subtitle: Commercial & Offices
description: A prestigious banking facility that combines security, functionality, and aesthetic excellence. The design reflects financial stability through materials and spatial planning, while incorporating Bhutanese artistic traditions in interior detailing. The building serves as a landmark for modern banking infrastructure in Bhutan.

title: Electricity Regulatory Authority
subtitle: Public Architecture
description: A modern office building designed for the Electricity Regulatory Authority. The structure balances contemporary architectural principles with Bhutanese design traditions. State-of-the-art facilities support regulatory operations while sustainable design features minimize environmental impact.

title: Clock Tower Redevelopment
subtitle: Landscape & Urbanism
description: A comprehensive landscape redevelopment of the iconic Clock Tower area. This project harmonizes modern design with Bhutanese cultural elements, creating a vibrant public space that celebrates the monument while providing contemporary amenities. The design integrates native plantings, traditional architectural motifs, and sustainable urban features.
